1e5e787e.text:
the next day. He was quickly buried, without ceremony, in a hastily dug grave on the outskirts of the cemetary. Because Morgan committed murder against innocents, something that went completely against his beliefs and his nature, and because of the grief that he held in being unable to save his family, Morgan could not die a peaceful death, and lived on as one of the restless dead.

Only days later, his grave was disturbed, and his body could not be found. The being that was Morgan now
1e5e787e.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

286e198d.text: there, he decided, against his better judgement, to stop by the Raven Hill cemetary. Morgan spent hours walking amongst the gravestones. He recognized many names of people that he knew and became more and more distraught. Then he saw them: a small, untended plot amongst the many with three small gravestones. A feeling of dread washed over him as he approached. Morgan brushed off the dust of the most prominent gravestone to reveal the name on it. Simply carved upon the grave, letters spelled out
286e198d.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

28e3ad3b.text:
his worst fear:

Lys Ladimore
Beloved Wife and Mother

Morgan's apprehension turned to dismay and then to grief, and he fell to his knees weeping. For hours he stared at that one grave, begging the cold stone for forgiveness and sobbing apologies. Then, hours later, something in him snapped, and he began to lash out. He brought his sword out of its scabbard and began to rain blows on the gravestones, screaming in rage. Blind in his fury, he lashed out and swung wildly, catching the notice
28e3ad3b.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

38d59472.text:
headed towards the village to find answers, and, he hoped, his wife and children.

Morgan inquired about his family, but could not find any answers. A priest in Darkshire, as it was now called, said that he might search the cemetary at Raven Hill for a gravestone. Morgan refused to believe that his family was dead, and continued to search every farm and house in Duskwood, but to no avail.

Morgan rode from Darkshire to nearby Lakeshire, thinking that perhaps his family had fled. On his way
38d59472.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

4509354d.text:
Lordaeron. Morgan was called to the side of the legendary paladin Uther the Lightbringer to fight against the orcs and the undead. Leaving his wife and children in the safety of his home, Morgan left for war.

The years passed and the war dragged on, and Morgan would witness many horrific events, including the disbanding of the Paladins of the Silver Hand, the death of Uther and the spread of the plague. The only thing that kept him from the brink of madness was the knowledge that he would
4509354d.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

6b67c9a7.text:
someday be reunited with his wife and children.

Morgan would eventually return to his homeland, but find it nothing like how he remembered it. The once verdant forest was corrupted and teemed with the undead and other dark forces. Destroyed houses and farms could be found everywhere, and the cemetary near Raven's Hill now dominated much of the area. A shocked and bewildered Morgan eventually made his way to his home, only to find it in ruins. Not knowing what had befallen his homeland, he
6b67c9a7.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

b1f65f40.text:
of a trio of the cemetary's attendants. As they tried to restrain him, he turned his focus to them, hurling accusations of guilt upon the innocent attendants, then killed them all.

Later, when the rage had passed, realization crept into Morgan's mind, and he saw his bloody sword driven into the chests of one of the attendants. Driven to the brink by his emotions, he removed his belt knife and plunged it into his heart.

Morgan Ladimore's body and the three bodies of his victims were found
b1f65f40.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

e772416c.text: wanders Duskwood, consumed by his grief over the loss of his wife and children and his own self-hatred. Mor'Ladim, as he now calls himself, roams Duskwood with mindless vengeance and hatred, and has been known to commit murder indiscriminately.
e772416c.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

e772d22d.text:
Morgan Ladimore was a great and noble knight who fought in defense of the innocent, the poor, and the afflicted. For many years, he worked diligently throughout the outlying areas of Azeroth, bringing relief to the suffering and swift justice to evildoers.

He was married to a young girl named Lys in the summer of his eighteenth year. They were much in love with each other and would eventually produce three children, a son and two daughters.

Morgan was thirty-two when war broke out in
e772d22d.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

10930|a665cdb8.name: Dargh Trueaim
10930|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

1241|4a926ca6.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|4a926ca6.text: Good day to ye lad. Can I be of service?

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1252|83b3b21e.name: Senir Whitebeard
1252|83b3b21e.text: Greetings and salutations to you, good $r. P'rhaps you'd like to share a drink with me, help fight off the chill of the wind? Come, I've more than enough to share.

12716|2ba45c06.name: Decedra Willham
12716|2ba45c06.text: I do so enjoy sitting out here, listening to the sounds of the Great Sea.  Oh, what?  Yes, there is a ship that will take you to Menethil Harbor.  It docks here from time to time.

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1292|ec1a6e0b.name: Maris Granger
1292|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

1344|d97361a1.name: Prospector Ironband
1344|d97361a1.text: Although we're trudging through a slow period at these ruins, I'm confident it won't last long.  But in the meantime, I could use someone like you.  Would you like to aid the Dwarven Explorers' Guild?

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1460|fccbd4ef.name: Unger Statforth
1460|fccbd4ef.text:
Sorry, but I am not disposed to sell horses to any individual who is not considered to be at least exalted to the Kingdom of Stormwind.  These steeds are the finest you'll find anywhere, and we certainly wouldn't want them in the hands of our enemies.

Not saying you're an enemy, of course... just earn the trust of Stormwind and then we can do business.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1676|66090c7a.name: Finbus Geargrind
1676|66090c7a.text: I'm never too busy to speak to a stranger! Almost never, anyway...

1699|0c543544.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1699|b48f927f.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

2277|985afd1f.name: Loremaster Dibbs
2277|985afd1f.text: Hello, $N! What can I do for you?

2367|c2467ddc.name: Donald Rabonne
2367|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256732|9285f4a0.name: Alynsia
256732|9285f4a0.text: You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!

257446|1e35c538.name: Teo Hammerstorm
257446|1e35c538.text:
The stone an' soil speak truer than any tongue, if ye quiet the clatter in yer heart long enough to hear 'em. 

If ye've the makings of a $c, I'll teach ye.

268318|84fc5809.name: Pinto
268318|84fc5809.text: <The horse whinnies softly as you approach it.>

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

271546|7dbe534f.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
271546|7dbe534f.text:
Lookin' fer the courier? Just flew off like a wee bird.

Can't say I blame the poor sod. These wendigos are nasty business.

276316|2d041d67.name: Raul Sweete
276316|2d041d67.text:
Looking for adventure, are ye? Well, look no further!

This here dock serves the one an' only boat that'll take ye to the distant elven lands of Darkshore, and Menethil Harbor without even leaving yer stateroom! How's that for adventure?!

2879|0e051c59.name: Karrina Mekenda
2879|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3136|e91b638d.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|e91b638d.text: Don't come out of the shadows like that. Next time give a girl some warning.

3179|c2467ddc.name: Harold Riggs
3179|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3290|16970404.name: Deek Fizzlebizz
3290|16970404.text: Where's my spinner? I just had it here somewhere...

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

3518|fe52f4ea.name: Thomas Miller
3518|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3545|0e051c59.name: Claude Erksine
3545|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4321|c5ceacbe.name: Baldruc
4321|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4419|f727dc49.name: Race Master Kronkrider
4419|f727dc49.text: Welcome to the races!  Enjoy your stay, and don't bet all your money in one place!

4453|f1c43d2c.name: Wizzle Brassbolts
4453|f1c43d2c.text: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.

460|86b6c1ef.name: Alamar Grimm
460|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5153|4acd68fa.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|4acd68fa.text: Hmm... you show a little promise, I'll give you that. Okay then, where were we?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5411|7162d6b1.name: Krinkle Goodsteel
5411|7162d6b1.text: Welcome to Tanaris, $N. How can I be of service to you today? You don't look like a blacksmith to me, but I know how looks can be deceiving.

5515|4a5716a3.name: Einris Brightspear
5515|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5564|568f7020.name: Simon Tanner
5564|568f7020.text: Hmm, I guess I can take on another student. Well, don't just stand there. Tell me what you're looking to learn.

5565|877c4b1d.name: Jillian Tanner
5565|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5594|bbdc551e.name: Alchemist Pestlezugg
5594|bbdc551e.text: In need of some alchemy supplies, are we?  Or do you have other business with me?

5612|86b6c1ef.name: Gimrizz Shadowcog
5612|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

6119|3f7fa6c3.name: Tog Rustsprocket
6119|3f7fa6c3.text: I wish the snow would just all melt away. It's always getting my robe wet and messing up everything!

6328|721fd095.name: Dannie Fizzwizzle
6328|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6376|721fd095.name: Wren Darkspring
6376|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6496|28f510c2.name: Brivelthwerp
6496|28f510c2.text: Can I interest you in some ice-cold ice cream?

6548|8a70d92b.name: Magus Tirth
6548|8a70d92b.text: Watch where you're stepping, $c, because I have a polymorph spell with your name on it...

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

714|7dd450ba.name: Talin Keeneye
714|7dd450ba.text: Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?

7733|606adfaa.name: Innkeeper Fizzgrimble
7733|606adfaa.text: Ah a visitor! Must be an adventurer, we don't get many tourists down this way. Grab a chair and a drink, make yourself comfortable. Say, you look like you have some meat on your bones. You thinkin about competing in the cage matches?

7804|b6dff793.name: Trenton Lighthammer
7804|b6dff793.text:
Sul'thraze... the first time I heard the word uttered I was around your age. It meant nothing to me then, as it means nothing to you now. It was not until a warband of trolls coming from Zul'Farrak laid waste to the land that I understood... and feared.

Many will tell you that the Splitblade of Suffering does not exist. That it's a myth; a rumor started to scare children 'straight.' But believe me, $r, it exists.

<Trenton loses focus as he runs his hand across the jagged scar on his face.>

7823|c5ceacbe.name: Bera Stonehammer
7823|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

786|b76e4f1a.name: Grelin Whitebeard
786|b76e4f1a.text: Greetings, lad. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

8736|92efd66e.name: Buzzek Bracketswing
8736|92efd66e.text: I've been working on a way to transport oil underground between major cities, but everyone tells me it's a pipe dream.

8962|0a5060df.name: Hilary
8962|0a5060df.text: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

8965|5a359b3f.name: Shawn
8965|5a359b3f.text: Hello there mister... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

254-complete.name: Unknown
254-complete.text:
You dig through the semi-loose dirt over the grave...and find the remains of a coffin.

Within the coffin you can feel the vibrating scrapes of clawed fingers and the gnashing of rotted teeth...

Will you open the coffin and retrieve the Embalmer's heart?
254-complete.title: Digging Through the Dirt

91900-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91900-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91900-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91900-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91900-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91900-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

94254-accept.name: Unknown
94254-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Greater Adept's Robe, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94254-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Greater Adept's Robe

94254-complete.name: Magus Tirth
94254-complete.text:
My new robe! Delightful!

At long last, I can don my robe AND my wizard hat.
94254-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Greater Adept's Robe

94254-progress.name: Magus Tirth
94254-progress.text: <Magus Tirth begins to cast Polymorph: Chicken on you.>
94254-progress.title: Craftsman's Writ: Greater Adept's Robe

96055-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96055-accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
96055-accept.title: Camping 101: Herbalism
